_readme: Production techniques. model_class states which yield model is scientifically honest for the technique: 'aquacrop_or_statistical' (soil-based open field) or 'empirical' (protected / soilless - AquaCrop is NOT applied). OpEx is built from components (labour, maintenance, plus electricity and water priced from metered use); it is never a single unsourced QAR/m2/year figure. Leaves with required_input=true have no defensible source and block the technique until a value is entered. 'profile_value' is used ONLY when the user explicitly accepts the unverified planning profile. requires = shared infrastructure groups (infrastructure.json) built once per plot.
